grounding.states: Mark Carney is the prime minister of Canada
grounding.from: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada, as of today, Oct 12, 2026.

grounding.states: He is still in office as of this week
grounding.from: Britannica's Carney page lists news items dated Oct. 6 and Oct. 8, 2026. They still call him Canada's leader, so he is still in office as of this week.

value.answer: Mark Carney. He became PM in March 2025 after Justin Trudeau's government collapsed, and he's still in the job as of this week.
